description: Frontend: add a per-match 'Submit Match N of X' control to ALL THREE stages with consistent UX, show a dismissible pop-up with the CUMULATIVE round standings through the submitted match, and when the LAST match of a round is submitted show a FULLSCREEN total round ranking (all players, totals, averages, ADVANCE/CUT/TIE). The fullscreen auto-detects/reports ties, hosts the add-extra-game flow, and recomputes live (via the FEAT-002 engine folding) as extra scores are entered, flipping TIE to ADVANCE/CUT as the bubble resolves and asking for another extra game while still tied. To Die already has a 'Match N of 8 done' button (data-action r2-done); To Live (5 games) and Rebirth (10 games) need an equivalent per-match submit control added. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: Study static/app.js: round() (To Live, renders all 5 games + score table), finalPage() (Rebirth, .match-tabs selector + per-game team cards), round2Page() (To Die, the prior-art .match-completion panel with the 'Match N of 8 done' accent button, data-action r2-done data-match), extras(key), openScreen/closeScreen (dialog.showModal()/animate/close, reducedMotion()), and the document click dispatcher. Also static/index.html (the single <dialog id='screen-dialog'>) and the per-game 'ready' flags in view.<stage>.games[].

Decide the submit mechanism: per the briefing, per-match 'ready' is already derivable from view.<stage>.games[].ready and cumulative standings-through-N are computable from existing per-game data, so a server round-trip is NOT required for To Live and Rebirth. Mirror the To Die UX visually (an accent 'Submit Match N of X' button in a .match-completion-style panel) but implement To Live/Rebirth submit as a client-side action that validates the match is ready, then opens the popup. Keep To Die's existing r2-done server flow intact (it also advances the sit-out draw); after a successful r2-done, additionally show the same popup/fullscreen. Document the chosen approach in findings.

Add a per-match 'Submit Match N of 5' control to the To Live page (round()) and a 'Submit Match N of 10' control to Rebirth (finalPage()), each disabled until that match's view games[N].ready is true and the stage is not stale. Reuse .panel/.match-completion/.accent classes. For stages with a .match-tabs selector (final), the 'current match' is the selected tab; for To Live (which renders all games at once) add a lightweight match selector or submit-per-game affordance consistent with the existing look (document choice).

Implement a dismissible pop-up that shows CUMULATIVE round standings THROUGH match N: rank, player name, total (goals or points), average (for round1/round2) , and provisional status. Compute cumulative-through-N from existing per-game data on the client (e.g. sum goals over games 0..N for each player, matches played over those games) OR reuse view rows when N is the last match. Render it in a modal using the SAME top-layer/dialog approach already in app.js (either a second <dialog> added to index.html or dialog.showModal() on a reused element). Respect reducedMotion() for any open/close animation. The user closes it and continues to the next match.

When the LAST match of a round is submitted (N == games count AND all games ready), show a FULLSCREEN total round ranking instead of (or escalating from) the popup: all players with totals, averages, and ADVANCE/CUT/TIE badges using the existing badge()/.status classes. If view.<stage> reports any TIE (a bubble exists), the fullscreen states that extra games are needed and embeds the add-extra-game controls (reuse the existing extras(key) 'Add extra game' action, data-action extra data-stage, and the per-player extra inputs). As extra scores are entered and saved, the view recomputes (FEAT-002 folding) and the fullscreen re-renders: TIE flips to ADVANCE/CUT for resolved bubble members, folded averages/totals update live, and if still tied it asks for another extra game. Provide a clear way to dismiss/close the fullscreen (reuse closeScreen-style handling / the dialog cancel pattern).

Wire new data-action handlers into the single document click dispatcher following existing patterns (e.g. data-action 'submit-match' with data-stage/data-match; keep r2-done calling progressRound2 then showing the popup/fullscreen). Ensure flush()/save() are awaited before server-dependent steps exactly as existing actions do. Keep accessibility: aria-live/role on the popup status, focus management like openScreen.

Add minimal CSS to static/style.css for the per-match popup and the fullscreen round-ranking takeover, reusing existing tokens/classes (#screen-dialog, .panel, .match-completion, .status/.advance/.cut/.tie, .podium). The single-line minified format of style.css must be preserved (append new rules in the same compact style).

Extend tests/test_ui.cjs following its vm-sandbox conventions (stubbed document/fetch/crypto, driving render() and the click dispatcher): (1) To Live and Rebirth each render a 'Submit Match N' control that is disabled until the match is ready; (2) submitting a match opens the popup and the popup HTML contains the cumulative standings (ranks/names/totals) through that match; (3) submitting the LAST match opens the fullscreen total ranking containing ADVANCE/CUT/TIE badges; (4) when a tie exists the fullscreen offers the add-extra-game control (data-action extra), and after an extra score is applied the re-rendered fullscreen reflects the folded recompute (TIE flips or asks again). Build the needed fixtures via the existing execFileSync(python ...) pattern. Keep the existing Round 1/Round 2 assertions passing.
Run `node tests/test_ui.cjs` (exit 0) and `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` (still green).
acceptance_criteria: To Live, To Die, and Rebirth each expose a per-match submit control labeled with the match number and round size (e.g. 'Submit Match 3 of 5'), disabled until that match is ready.
Submitting a non-final match opens a dismissible popup showing cumulative round standings through that match (rank, name, total, average/status).
Submitting the final match of a round opens a fullscreen total round ranking with ADVANCE/CUT/TIE for all players.

If a tie exists, the fullscreen says extra games are needed and lets the user add an extra game there; entering/saving extra scores re-renders the fullscreen with folded averages/totals and flips resolved bubble members from TIE to ADVANCE/CUT, asking for another extra game while still tied.
node tests/test_ui.cjs exits 0 with new assertions for the submit control, popup, and fullscreen; python suite stays green.
verification: node tests/test_ui.cjs  => exit 0 (new submit/popup/fullscreen assertions pass)

Single-invocation /projects/sandbox probe script: start `python3 app.py --no-browser --port

--data /tmp/t.json`, GET /api/state, PUT a tie-inducing state + an extra game, confirm the view flips TIE to ADVANCE/CUT after folding, then stop the server
findings:
IMPLEMENTED the per-match submit + cumulative popup + final fullscreen on all three stages. Only frontend touched: static/app.js, static/index.html, static/style.css, tests/test_ui.cjs. engine.py and app.py are UNCHANGED (no new endpoint was needed). node tests/test_ui.cjs exits 0 (old assertions + 3 new blocks), python stays 40/40, and /projects/sandbox/probe3.sh confirms the live server folds a round2 6th/7th TIE to ADVANCE/CUT after an extra game.

SUBMIT CONTROL PER STAGE:
- To Live (round()): all 5 games still render at once; added a lightweight .match-tabs match selector (data-r1-game 0..4, module var round1Game) plus a .match-completion panel 'Submit Match N of 5' (data-action=submit-match data-stage=round1 data-match=N). CLIENT-SIDE submit (no server round-trip): disabled until view.round1.games[N].ready and not stale.
- Rebirth (finalPage()): reuses the existing .match-tabs (finalGame is the selected tab); added a .match-completion 'Submit Match N of 10' (data-action=submit-match data-stage=final data-match=g) after Live standings. CLIENT-SIDE submit, disabled until view.final.games[g].ready and not stale.
- To Die (round2Page()): KEPT the existing 'Match N of 8 done' server flow (data-action=r2-done -> progressRound2('done',match) PUT /api/round2-draw, advances the sit-out draw). The r2-done handler now ALSO calls openMatchResult('round2',match-1) after the server call returns, so To Die gets the same popup (non-final) / fullscreen (match 8) without a second endpoint.

CLIENT-VS-SERVER CHOICE: per-match 'ready' is derivable from view.<stage>.games[].ready and cumulative-through-N is computable client-side, so To Live/Rebirth submit is purely client-side (openMatchResult validates readiness, then shows the dialog). To Die keeps its one server call because that call also advances the draw; no new app.py endpoint was added.

POPUP (non-final match): dismissible modal in a NEW <dialog id=result-dialog> added to index.html (role=status aria-live=polite on #result-content). resultPopup(key,match) renders CUMULATIVE standings THROUGH match N computed by cumulativeStandings(key,n): round1/round2 sum state.<stage>.players goals over games 0..N (skipping scheduled sit-outs via view.schedule) and show total goals + average (= goals/played), sorted by average then total; the final sums view.rows[].game_points[0..N] for total points + avg points. Columns RANK/PLAYER/TOTAL/AVG. Dismiss via the 'Close ✕' button (data-action=close-result) or ESC (result-dialog 'cancel' handler -> closeResult()). openScreen-style focus: the close button is focused on open; reducedMotion() gates the open animation.

FULLSCREEN (last match, N==count-1 AND every game ready): openMatchResult sets resultFinal=true and toggles #result-dialog.fullscreen. resultFullscreen(key) shows ALL players sorted by rank with totals, averages and ADVANCE/CUT/TIE via badge(). A .result-banner reports '✓ ROUND SETTLED' when no TIE, or '⚠ EXTRA GAMES NEEDED' when any row is TIE; when tied it embeds extras(key) (the existing 'Add extra game' control, data-action=extra data-stage=<stage>, plus per-player extra inputs). LIVE RE-RENDER: save() now also calls renderResult() on success, so entering/saving extra scores recomputes the FEAT-002 fold and re-renders the fullscreen in place: TIE flips to ADVANCE/CUT for resolved bubble members and folded goals/averages/totals update; still-tied keeps the banner asking for another extra game. Dismiss via Close/ESC.

ACCESSIBILITY/FOCUS: #result-content is role=status aria-live=polite; the error() helper now reparents #error into the TOPMOST open dialog (#result-content when the result dialog is open, else .screen-shell, else body) so validation errors surface above the popup/fullscreen. renderResult() preserves focus/selection on any focused [data-path] input and open <details>, so typing extra scores is not interrupted by the live re-render.

CSS: appended compact rules to the single-line style.css for #result-dialog (centered modal), #result-dialog.fullscreen (98vw/96dvh takeover), .result-shell (scroll container), .result-head/.result-close and .result-banner (.tie/.done), reusing existing tokens (.panel, .status/.advance/.cut/.tie, table(), --pink/--green).

TESTS (tests/test_ui.cjs): upgraded the element() stub with open/classList/showModal/close/animate/querySelector so the result dialog can be driven. Added a FEAT-003 block asserting: (1) To Live renders 'Submit Match 1 of 5' + 5-match selector and Rebirth renders 'Submit Match 1 of 10', each disabled when games[N].ready is false; (2) clicking submit-match on a non-final match opens the popup with cumulative RANK/PLAYER/TOTAL columns and every player name; close-result dismisses it; (3) submitting the last match opens the fullscreen with ADVANCE/CUT badges and 'ROUND SETTLED'; (4) a round2 6th/7th tie fixture opens the fullscreen with 'EXTRA GAMES NEEDED', a TIE badge and data-action=extra, and after swapping in the folded view (p8=23 ADVANCE, p4=19 CUT) renderResult() re-renders to 'ROUND SETTLED' with the folded total 23. Existing Round 1/Round 2 assertions untouched and still pass. Added /projects/sandbox/probe3.sh for the single-invocation live-server fold check.

REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (2026-10-07-055849-review.md, NEEDS_CHANGES -> addressed, frontend-only, no engine change):
- ISSUE 1 FIXED (popup missing provisional status): resultPopup() now renders a 5th STATUS column via badge(r.status), surfacing the PLAYED/PENDING value that cumulativeStandings() already computed. Matches user point 2 and the README promise. New test asserts <th>STATUS</th> and a PLAYED badge in the popup HTML.
- ISSUE 2 FIXED (final fullscreen AVG column duplicated the total): resultFullscreen() previously fell back to r.total for final rows (which carry no 'average'), printing the total twice under 'AVG PTS'. Now an avgOf(r) helper computes average POINTS PER GAME for the final as r.total/r.played (round1/round2 keep r.average = goals per match). Relabeled the final header 'AVG PTS / GAME' to disambiguate. New test opens the Rebirth fullscreen on match 10 and asserts the header plus the computed avg (e.g. Player 1 total 102 -> avg 10.2), distinct from the total.
- ISSUE 3 JUSTIFIED (FINAL/TIE vs ADVANCE/CUT wording): kept the engine's FINAL/TIE badges for Rebirth. Rebirth decides the podium, not a cut to a next round, so 'ADVANCE'/'CUT' would be misleading there; FINAL is the podium-correct label and the engine status value must not change. Documented this distinction in the README (cutting rounds show ADVANCE/CUT/TIE; the final shows FINAL/TIE). No code change beyond the README clarification.
- ISSUE 4 JUSTIFIED (final 1st/2nd prize-order tie forces an extra game): pre-existing engine behavior, not introduced by this task. A podium tie entirely above the cut still needs resolving because the prize amounts differ by rank (prizes[0] vs prizes[1]), so prize order genuinely requires a tiebreak. Left as-is per briefing (do not change engine fold semantics). Engine/python tests unchanged (still 40 OK).
